contacts.label: Cloud Contacts (Fossify)

build._doc: Fossify Contacts. gradle task + keystore signing. Unlike Fossify Phone, Contacts dimensions by flavor (core/foss/gplay), so the task pins the FOSS release variant (self-distributed, no Play deps) and apk_glob matches its flavored output path — the flavorless apk/release/*.apk glob matched nothing (GHA 32143946025). APPLICATION_ID is passed as -P so patch 0002's findProperty override installs the fork under its own unique package (namespace/code stays org.fossify.contacts).

contacts.comment: Fossify Contacts fork — the constellation address book. Merges local phone + synced-account (Gmail) contacts natively via ContactsContract; patch series adds LinkedIn/Instagram social import (export files → vCard → existing importer) so social handles live on each contact as tappable profile URLs. Call/SMS/mail actions fire standard intents, landing in cloud-dialer / cloud-mail as the constellation default handlers.

gh_release._doc: Rolling GH release 'latest' (shared across the ea_cloud-* apps; each contributes a distinctly-named APK asset), overwritten every main push so https://github.com/diegonmarcos/cloud-unix/releases/latest/download/cloud-comms-contacts.apk stays stable. Published by `build.sh gh-release-fork contacts` (ship-cloud-contacts.yml), which uploads dist/cloud-comms-contacts.apk with --clobber. Consumed by ea_cloud-superapp ui.external_apps[cloud-contacts].install_apk_url. The immutable timestamped per-build release (RSS notification) is separate and stays --latest=false.
